annotations.title: Two to five agents side by side, from each one’s record

description: Compare 2 to 5 agent addresses side by side on one taxonomy, from the record we keep for every paid address: identity (registered name, ERC-8004 registrations, rails, chains), custom (counterparties, counterparties with no observed payment back (`counterpartiesWithoutObservedPaymentBack`; `independent` is its deprecated alias), payers it also paid, the largest payer’s share, the share who came back), money (received and paid out where priced, x402 payments), work (ACP jobs, completed, completion rate, Olas deliveries) and activity (dealings over 30 and 90 days, first and last paid). Free. Each cell is {state: "read", value, readAt, source} or {state: "unknown", why}; an address with no paid record is a row of unknowns, never zeros. There is no winner and no ranking; `sort` orders by the one figure you name. No payment back on the rails we read is not proof the payers are different parties. Each row keeps address, entity, service, operator, software and agent apart (`identityLayers`: only the address is observed) and gives each registry its own evidence level (`registryEvidence`: ERC-8004 self_registered, ACP/Masumi/Olas protocol_recorded, catalogue third_party_listing, endpoint probe probe_response); a registration is not proof of ownership or autonomy.

addresses.description: 2 to 5 agent addresses (EVM, Solana or Cardano), comma-separated.

sort.description: Optional. Orders the rows by that one figure, unknowns last.

name: compare_agents

agents.description: One row per address: `address`, `page` (its aspern.org page), `cells` keyed by field (counterpartiesWithoutObservedPaymentBack, and `independent` as its deprecated alias), `identityLayers` {address, entity, service, operator, software, agent; each {state, basis}}, `registryEvidence` [{registry, label, level, state, count, establishes, doesNotEstablish}], `identitySays`, `readAt` and `says`.

answerLead.description: SINCE 2026-11-28: at most three lines before the full answer, from its own fields: `text`, `result`, `risks` (up to two), `asOf`, `coverage`, `unknowns` (up to two) and `deprecatedFields` (legacy duplicates this answer still carries). The full answer governs. Added by this MCP server; the REST route behind the tool does not carry it.

fields.description: The taxonomy in display order: group, key, label.

limits.description: What this comparison does not do.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

ownershipIndependence.description: Always not_established: no payment back is not separate owners.

readAtSpreadMinutes.description: Minutes between the earliest and latest record in the table; null where no address has a record.

sort.description: Null without a sort key; otherwise `key`, `order`, `unknownLast` and `says`.
